hook.name: RotatoHook
hook.description: Shared hook for the rotato.fun platform. Only registered token managers can create pools or add liquidity. Public swaps pay a per-coin fee (1–10%) in the quote currency, minted as ERC-6909 claims to the FeeRouter; the pool LP fee is always overridden to 0. Records start-of-block sqrt prices to enable managers to detect intra-block price manipulation.
